name: Octo
summary: Octo is a small transformer (27M and 93M variants) trained on 800k trajectories from Open X-Embodiment, with a diffusion action head producing continuous action chunks. Its defining property is a modular tokenizer layout: new observation streams (wrist cameras, joint states) or new action spaces attach at fine-tune time without touching pretrained weights, so a lab can adapt it on a single GPU in hours.
innovation: Block-wise attention layout letting input and output modules be added or removed after pretraining.
Diffusion head for continuous, multimodal action chunks instead of discretized tokens.
Fully open weights, data mixture and training code.
matters: Made generalist-policy research reproducible outside large industry labs.
limits: No language-model backbone, so semantic generalization is far below RT-2 or OpenVLA.
lineage: Open X-Embodiment data plus Diffusion Policy's action head in a compact, adaptable transformer.
